decisions.reason: This fashion-driven devore decoration fabric faces normal collection rotation risk three years after launch, but there is no evidence of a shortfall, the industry is growing and the firm promises reorder continuity, so there is little cause for problemistic search.

The transparent burnout fabric sits close to the core decorative offer, which a firm with a large stocked warehouse can carry, and without signs of underperformance it stays until the collection is next refreshed.
This burnout decorative fabric overlaps somewhat with Products A and B, which raises the chance of pruning, but in a growing market there is no clear shortfall against aspirations to trigger a drop.
Velour-like upholstery fabric has steady demand and longer life cycles than decorative fashion fabrics, so results likely meet aspirations.
A flame-retardant plain inbetween fabric is a functional staple for retail and contract buyers, supporting stable reorders with little reason to drop it.
Satin polyester lining is a basic complement to the firm's made-to-measure sewing and in-stock range, so it likely performs satisfactorily and is cheap to carry.
